scripts.python:deps: if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then UV_CACHE_DIR=../../.uv-cache uv venv --python "$(command -v python3)" --allow-existing .venv && UV_CACHE_DIR=../../.uv-cache uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -q -r apps/backend/requirements.txt -r apps/backend/requirements-dev.txt; else [ -x .venv/bin/python ] || python3 -m venv .venv; .venv/bin/python -m pip install -q -r apps/backend/requirements.txt -r apps/backend/requirements-dev.txt; fi
scripts.nx:prepare: mkdir -p node_modules; [ -f ../../node_modules/.modules.yaml ] || CI=1 pnpm install --filter @questurian/ai-blog-writer...; [ -f node_modules/.modules.yaml ] || cp ../../node_modules/.modules.yaml node_modules/.modules.yaml
scripts.dev:local: (lsof -ti:4003 -ti:3003 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true); pnpm run nx:prepare; [ -x .venv/bin/python ] || pnpm run python:deps; .venv/bin/python -c "import uvicorn, fastapi" >/dev/null 2>&1 || pnpm run python:deps; NX_DAEMON=false NX_WORKSPACE_DATA_DIRECTORY=.cache/nx/workspace-data NX_CACHE_DIRECTORY=.cache/nx/cache nx run-many -t serve --projects=@questurian/abw-server,@questurian/abw-client
scripts.dev:local:full: (lsof -ti:4010 -ti:4003 -ti:3003 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true); pnpm run nx:prepare; [ -x .venv/bin/python ] || pnpm run python:deps; .venv/bin/python -c "import uvicorn, fastapi" >/dev/null 2>&1 || pnpm run python:deps; NX_DAEMON=false NX_WORKSPACE_DATA_DIRECTORY=.cache/nx/workspace-data NX_CACHE_DIRECTORY=.cache/nx/cache nx run-many -t serve --projects=@questurian/abw-server,@questurian/abw-client,@questurian/abw-converter
scripts.dev:clean: (lsof -ti:4010 -ti:4003 -ti:3003 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true); pnpm install --filter @questurian/ai-blog-writer... && pnpm run python:deps && pnpm run nx:prepare && NX_DAEMON=false NX_WORKSPACE_DATA_DIRECTORY=.cache/nx/workspace-data NX_CACHE_DIRECTORY=.cache/nx/cache nx run-many -t serve
scripts.build: vite build --config apps/frontend/vite.config.ts && PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=.cache/pycache python3 -m compileall apps/backend/app
scripts.lint: pnpm run python:deps && pnpm run nx:prepare && NX_DAEMON=false NX_WORKSPACE_DATA_DIRECTORY=.cache/nx/workspace-data NX_CACHE_DIRECTORY=.cache/nx/cache nx run-many -t lint
scripts.test: pnpm run python:deps && pnpm run nx:prepare && NX_DAEMON=false NX_WORKSPACE_DATA_DIRECTORY=.cache/nx/workspace-data NX_CACHE_DIRECTORY=.cache/nx/cache nx run-many -t test
scripts.docker:build: pnpm run nx:prepare && NX_DAEMON=false NX_WORKSPACE_DATA_DIRECTORY=.cache/nx/workspace-data NX_CACHE_DIRECTORY=.cache/nx/cache nx run-many -t docker-build
